issues.jp_before: 参観日[さんかんび]{がてら|gatera}、担任[たんにん]{の|no-possessive}先生[せんせい]{と|to-with}進路[しんろ]{の|no-possessive}話[はなし]{を|o-object}した。
issues.problem: がてら needs an action noun; 参観日 is a day, so 参観日がてら is unnatural.
issues.action: Changed to 授業参観がてら and adjusted the English.

issues.jp_before: 同窓会[どうそうかい]{がてら|gatera}、母校[ぼこう]{を|o-object}見[み]て回[まわ]った。
issues.problem: 同窓会 is an event, not an activity, so 同窓会がてら is marginal; it also repeated 見て回った from another line.
issues.action: Rewrote it as オープンキャンパスの見学がてら、姉の下宿に/へ寄った and set f to 1.

issues.jp_before: 就職[しゅうしょく]{の|no-possessive}お礼[れい]{がてら/かたがた|gatera}、先輩[せんぱい]{に|ni-recipient}菓子[かし]折[お]り{を|o-object}贈[おく]った。
issues.problem: Sending the gift is itself the thanks, so 'お礼がてら' (thanks plus something else) is illogical.
issues.action: Rewrote it as お礼がてら/かたがた、先輩を食事に誘った with new English.

issues.jp_before: 会社[かいしゃ]{の|no-possessive}帰[かえ]り{がてら|gatera}、息子[むすこ]{の|no-possessive}塾[じゅく]{に|ni-destination}傘[かさ]{を|o-object}届[とど]けた。
issues.problem: The non-focus destination slot was missing the equally natural へ.

issues.jp_before: 娘[むすめ]{は|wa-topic}幼[おさな]い{ながらに/ながら/ながらも|nagarani}、毎朝[まいあさ]弟[おとうと]{の|no-possessive}世話[せわ]{を|o-object}している。
issues.problem: The why said the other forms 'do not attach to a noun', but 幼い is an adjective.
issues.action: Rewrote the why for 幼いながらに.

issues.jp_before: 我[わ]が家[や]{は|wa-topic}昔[むかし]{ながらに|nagarani}大晦日[おおみそか]{に|ni-time}年越[としこ]しそば{を|o-object}食[た]べる。
issues.problem: The English was redundant ('New Year's Eve noodles on the last day of the year').
issues.action: Changed the English to 'still eats toshikoshi soba on New Year's Eve, just as in the old days'.
